title: Before Biggie Predating Tupac Lemon Henry Jefferson lie frozen dead in streets of Chicago Heart attack? Poison? Robbed of royalties? Blind Lemmon Jeff
summary: Before Biggie Predating Tupac Lemon Henry Jefferson lie frozen dead in streets of Chicago Heart attack? Poison? Robbed of royalties? Blind Lemmon Jefferson father of American music, forgotten buried in an unmarked grave #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Before Biggie
Predating Tupac
Lemon Henry Jefferson
lie frozen
dead in streets
of Chicago
Heart attack?
Poison?
Robbed of royalties?
Blind Lemmon Jefferson
father of American
music, forgotten
buried in an unmarked grave
#smallpoems
